_comment: Open-data and imagery sources used beside OpenStreetMap for this venue. The builder reads this file on every build to wire datasets and credits. Official website data is fetched by `npm run venues:research -- big-kahunas --fetch` into official-cache.json in this package. Official park maps live under maps/.

sources.used_for: Park geometry, named water slides, pools, paths, buildings, and the venue boundary.
Walking paths OpenStreetMap does not draw, and ride positions where OSM names geometry but not the attraction.
sources.notes: served_via records the channel THIS SURVEY actually used and is left alone — imagery.geojson is a hand-surveyed record and rewriting how it was made would falsify it, not correct it. What is new is county_service_url: Okaloosa County serves this same imagery directly, verified by exporting a 2048x2048 TIFF over Big Kahuna's and confirming the slide complex, wave pool and go-kart loop. That is the admissible channel a re-survey or an ingest should use (the _dynamic service, not the cached one, which sets exportTilesAllowed=false). capture_date said 2025-03-01, outside the window the county publishes ("collected from 12-01-2024 through 02-02-2025"). horizontal_accuracy_m said 0.19 with no source behind it, against a Florida county ortho standard of 0.76 m at 95% CI. Both corrected rather than left as unevidenced claims. licence_class stays null: the raster is a Pictometry/EagleView product the county licensed in, not a county work. Okaloosa GIS publishes its Chapter 119 public-domain sentence on 13 vector items and zero imagery items across all 193 in its ArcGIS org, and every imagery service publishes licenseInfo: "". Chapter 119 is a right of access, not a redistribution grant.

sources.used_for: Food, restroom, and river labels; walking paths and ride entrances when georeferenced (illustrated / not-to-scale — use TPS). Primary map for builder testing and production georef.
Height requirements and attraction names for the 2026 season.

adapters.ropedrop: RopeDrop open data covers Disney/Universal parks only — not applicable to this water park.
adapters.parks-api: ThemeParks.wiki has no entity for Big Kahuna's Destin — inventory comes from official_site + OSM.
adapters.rcdb: RCDB is coaster-focused; this water park has no roller coasters to compare.
adapters.queue-times: Queue-Times does not list Big Kahuna's Destin — wait/inventory QA N/A.

research.note: LLM may propose aliases and height candidates from official HTML; code decides. LLM park-map search is required to locate guest-map image/PDF assets for tracing. Never invents coordinates.
